# NN Infra — Project N

> Project N by NN Infra: 20 premium 3 & 4 BHK apartments (G+4) on 20,000 sq ft in Bengaluru, launching January 2027. NN Infra is a Nethravathi Group venture; the group has been developing land in and around Bengaluru since 1986.

## Project N
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Homes: 20 premium homes, 3 & 4 BHK
- Floors: G+4
- Land area: 20,000 sq ft
- Launch: January 2027
- Amenities: private lifts, landscaped gardens, club lounge, children's play area, 24x7 security, power backup, CCTV surveillance
- Limited fractional ownership positions open in 2027

## Company
- NN Infra, part of the Nethravathi Group (founded 1986 by Mr. B K Nagabhushana Reddy)
- Chairman & Director: Mr. Jayanth N
- Tagline: Legacy. Design. Delivery.
